name: Bitter Toad
text: Whenever this deals damage to an enemy, that enemy gains Nightshade.
golden_text: Whenever this deals damage to an enemy, or is dealt damage by an enemy, that enemy gains Nightshade.

source.note: Nightshade: whenever a unit with Nightshade is attacked, it first loses half its current Health, rounded down. Health loss, not damage. Lasts this combat.
